description.value: Bellevue Creek Greenway is a municipal nature reserve in Kelowna, BC, following the Bellevue Creek corridor through the city. As a linear greenway, it likely offers a natural, off-road route through an urban area — the kind of quiet, scenic detour that touring cyclists often seek when passing through a city. It is managed by the City of Kelowna as part of its parks and beaches network.
